title: [Renseikai] Attendance Synchronization – Back Office to Salesforce – Absent to Attend – Cleared values reflected
description: AC 03 — Decision Table and Regression — A teacher changes an absent attendance record to Attend in Back Office; Salesforce reflects Attend with blank absence fields.
preconditions:
HQ Staff is logged in to Back Office; HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Renseikai Salesforce.
Lesson RSK-ATT-001 / Student A: Status Absent; Reason Traffic Issue; Notice No Contact in Back Office and Salesforce.
steps_actions:
1. In Back Office, open Collect Attendance for Lesson RSK-ATT-001 and select Student A.
2. Change Student A Attendance Status to Attend and save.
3. In Salesforce, open Student A Student Session for Lesson RSK-ATT-001.
steps_result:
1. Student A shows Absent; Traffic Issue; No Contact.
2. Back Office shows Attend; blank Reason; blank Notice.
3. Salesforce shows Attend; blank Reason; blank Notice.
steps_data:
1. Lesson RSK-ATT-001; Student A.
2. Absent → Attend.
3. Salesforce Student A.

title: [Renseikai] Attendance Correction – Salesforce Student Session – Selected attendance controls – Each x icon clears its field
description: AC 02 — Component — All three selected attendance controls provide and apply their clear affordance.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Renseikai Salesforce.
Lesson RSK-ATT-008 / Student H: Status Absent; Reason Traffic Issue; Notice No Contact.
steps_actions:
1. Open Student H in Lesson RSK-ATT-008 and select Edit.
2. Clear Attendance Reason using its x icon.
3. Re-select Traffic Issue; clear Attendance Notice using its x icon.
4. Re-select No Contact; clear Attendance Status using its x icon.
steps_result:
1. All three selected controls show x icons.
2. Reason is blank; Status Absent and Notice No Contact remain.
3. Notice is blank; Status Absent and Reason Traffic Issue remain.
4. Status; Reason; and Notice are blank.
steps_data:
1. Lesson RSK-ATT-008; Student H.
2. Clear Reason.
3. Clear Notice.
4. Clear Status.
